title: Group two values in a pair
objective: Make a pair of two values, take it apart with match, and return a pair from a function.

body.text: A pair holds two values, and the two values can have different types. a pair of builds one, and say shows it as (left, right). To take a pair apart, use match with when a pair of and then a name for each part.

body.title: Build and take apart a pair
body.code:
make point equal to a pair of 3 and 4
say point
make entry equal to a pair of "Ada" and 100
match entry
    when a pair of who and points
        say "{who} scored {points}"

body.text: A function can give back a pair too. Write returns a pair of with the two types, and gives back a pair of with the two values.

body.title: Return a pair from a function
body.code:
function spread
    takes number called n
    returns a pair of number and number
    gives back a pair of n and n times 2

make both equal to spread 5
match both
    when a pair of low and high
        say "{low} to {high}"

body.prompt: The program prints only the x part of the pair. Make it print both parts: x is 3 and y is 4.
body.starter:
make point equal to a pair of 3 and 4
match point
    when a pair of x and y
        say "x is {x}"
body.solution:
make point equal to a pair of 3 and 4
match point
    when a pair of x and y
        say "x is {x}"
        say "y is {y}"

checks.description: It prints x is 3 and then y is 4
